name: Rune Slayer
desc:
(CONSOLE WITH KBM IS ENABLED) (L to Shift Lock)

A fierce open-world RPG. Create allies and get stronger or the wilds will claim you.

-Controls are listed in the Menu (M)
-Your first slot will be rolled as a common species
-Form a party by clicking a player's name on the in-game leaderboard (Top Right)
-Credits are listed in the Title Screen
